demo-crash-0312.setup: 03:12 at Junction, Dipoli, Espoo. The team's demo crashed in front of a mentor ten minutes ago. Judges see the demo at 09:00. Cold pizza, a humanoid robot lying on its side on the floor, one laptop still open. The pets are huddled by the laptop deciding what to do next.

beats.4: The robot on the floor suddenly twitches its arm on its own.
beats.8: The only open laptop shows 3% battery.

lunch-cheating.setup: Saturday lunch queue at Junction. A participant holding a tray asks the pets: 'Honestly — is it cheating if an AI writes almost all of our hackathon code?' The pets do not agree with each other.

beats.5: The participant admits their teammate already did exactly that last night.
